newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to issue 18-mth T-bills April 2 - MinFin.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to issue 18-mth T-bills April 2 - MinFin.

text.p: Ukraine will issue its first 18-month discount Treasury bills at auctions starting on April 2, the head of the Finance Ministry's securities department said on Wednesday.
Alexander Patoka told Reuters there would be no limits placed on issue volumes, and said regular sales of three-, six-, nine-, and 12-month T-bills would also take place.
A government resolution issued last month told the ministry to look into issuing paper with two- and three-year maturities.
Ukraine plans to issue 3.5 billion hryvnias worth of paper this year to raise money to finance the deficit.
Yields from April 1 sales stood at 24.47 percent for three-month bills, 30.26 percent for six-month bills, 33.01 percent for nine-month bills, and 38.05 percent for 12-month bills.
